Fact.Name: This row reports an installment liability assumed as transferee
Fact.Description: True when this row reports the remaining section 965(h) installment liability of another taxpayer that you assumed as transferee under an agreement with the IRS. Columns b through i are skipped on such a row; the assumed amount goes in column j as a positive number and the transferor's identification number in column k.

Fact.Name: Transferor's original net 965 tax liability (installment base of an assumed liability)
Fact.Description: For a row that reports an installment liability you assumed as transferee: the transferor's original net 965 tax liability for the column a year. The installment percentages for 2025 apply to this original amount, not to the remaining balance you assumed.

Fact.Name: The 2025 trigger of this deferred S corporation liability is a liquidation, asset sale or cessation
Fact.Description: For a row reporting a deferred S corporation-related liability triggered in 2025: true when the triggering event was a liquidation or sale of substantially all the assets of the S corporation, its cessation of business, its ceasing to exist, or a similar circumstance. Such a liability can be paid in installments only with the consent of the IRS.

Fact.Name: The IRS consented to paying this triggered liability in installments
Fact.Description: For a liability triggered by a liquidation, asset sale or cessation: true when the IRS consented to the section 965(h) installment election. Without consent the column g answer is No and the whole triggered liability is payable in full (column h).

Fact.Name: This row is paid under the section 965(h) installment schedule
Fact.Description: True for an assumed installment liability (the transferee pays the remaining installments as if it were the transferor, and column g is skipped); otherwise the column g installment election, except that on a row triggered in 2025 by a liquidation, asset sale or cessation of the S corporation the election stands only with the consent of the IRS (without it the liability is payable in full).

Fact.Name: 2025 installment number on the original schedule (0 if outside the eight years)
Fact.Description: Which of the eight section 965(h) installments falls in 2025 for this row, computed from the row's column (a) year: year 1 is the year of the section 965(a) inclusion, of the triggering event, or of the transferor's liability for an assumed installment liability, and each later installment falls in the following year. A 2018 row is in its 8th installment and a 2025 row in its 1st; a 2017 row has run past its eight installments and is 0.

Fact.Name: Part of column j that is a subsequent adjustment made in 2025
Fact.Description: The part of this row's column j that is a subsequent adjustment to the net 965 tax liability made during 2025, such as an audit adjustment, as a positive number for an increase and a negative number for a decrease. Enter 0 when no adjustment was made this year; earlier years' adjustments stay in column j but are not entered here.

Fact.Name: Share of the liability scheduled in the installments due before 2025
Fact.Description: The total of the installment percentages whose due dates arrived before the 2025 installment: 0 for installment 1, 8 percent for installment 2, rising by 8 points through installment 6 (40 percent), then 55 percent before installment 7 and 75 percent before installment 8. A row past its eight installments has every installment date already arrived, 100 percent.

Fact.Name: Additional amount due for adjustments allocated to installments already due
Fact.Description: The part of a 2025 adjustment prorated to installments whose due dates have already arrived: the 2025 adjustment times the share of the liability scheduled before the 2025 installment, and never below zero. The 2025 installment's own share of the adjustment is already in the normal installment on the adjusted liability. When the increase is a deficiency due to negligence, intentional disregard of rules and regulations, or fraud (../currentYearAdjustmentNotProrated), the proration does not apply and the whole increase is payable now: this is then the increase less the part the normal 2025 installment already carries, so the two together pay the entire increase.

Fact.Name: The 2025 increase is a deficiency due to negligence, intentional disregard, or fraud
Fact.Description: QUESTION, asked only on a row with an installment election and a positive 2025 adjustment: "Is this 2025 increase a deficiency due to negligence, to intentional disregard of rules and regulations, or to fraud with intent to evade tax?" Yes means the increase is not prorated to the installments and is payable in full now. Unanswered or No means it is prorated, the general rule of the instructions.

Fact.Name: The 2025 increase is not prorated to the installments
Fact.Description: True when the 2025 adjustment is an increase (more than zero) and the filer answers that it is a deficiency due to negligence, intentional disregard of rules and regulations, or fraud; the proration of section 965(h)(4) then does not apply. False when the question is unanswered or answered No, or when the adjustment is zero or a decrease. Complete whenever the adjustment is answered.

Fact.Description: The deferred S corporation-related liability this Part IV row reports as triggered during 2025, as a positive amount whichever sign the column (f) entry carries (the printed column shows it negative). $0 when the entry is unanswered.

Fact.Name: Part IV column (f): total deferred S corporation-related liability triggered during 2025
Fact.Description: The total of every Part IV row's triggered amount, as a positive amount. $0 when Part IV is answered empty; Incomplete while Part IV is unanswered.

Fact.Name: Part I column (f) amount of a deferred S corporation liability triggered during 2025
Fact.Description: On a Part I row whose column (a) year is 2025 and that is not an assumed installment liability, the triggered deferred S corporation-related amount carried into column (f); $0 on every other row and when the amount is unanswered.

Fact.Name: Part I column (f): total triggered deferred S corporation-related liability on the 2025 rows
Fact.Description: The total of ../partITriggeredThisYear over every Part I row. $0 when Part I is answered empty; Incomplete while Part I is unanswered.

Fact.Name: Knockout: the 2025 triggered S corporation amounts in Part IV and Part I disagree
Fact.Description: Refuses a return whose Part IV column (f) total of deferred S corporation-related liability triggered during 2025 differs from the triggered amounts carried to column (f) of the 2025 rows of Part I. The instructions transfer the Part IV amount to Part I as a positive number; the Part I row is what brings the triggered tax onto the return, and the Part IV row is what takes it out of the deferred balance, so a difference either drops tax or misstates the deferred balance. False while either part is unanswered; the filer corrects one of the two entries.
